name: Peace of Maui
imageAlt: Peace of Maui website shown on a desktop display
body: Peace of Maui came to us after learning the hard way that “my cousin’s friend can build a website” isn’t always a good strategy. Their previous site was poorly designed, slow, and misrepresented their unique Airbnb-style property in upcountry Maui.

We stepped in to completely redesign their website, elevate their branding with professional photo retouching, and launch a targeted Google Ads campaign. The results have been powerful: steady bookings year-round — including during the off-season — and a massive improvement in user experience.
With 15 beautiful units on 2 acres of Maui’s serene countryside, Peace of Maui is finally getting the visibility and traction it deserves.
result: Google Ads increased bookings by 27% in the first 60 days.
